name: Enhanced Judgment
body:
School transmutation; Level inquisitor 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, you are considered three inquisitor levels higher for determining the bonuses granted from one active judgment. You may enhance only one judgment in this way, and the judgment must be selected at the time of casting. If you change this judgment for another, the spell ends.
